measurement: Annual actual cash capital expenditures for LNG facilities, audited by company and fiscal year

missing: cash paid for construction and development by facility
cash purchases of property plant and equipment
financing cash flows separated from capex

sourceExtractionProtocol: Read FY2025 consolidated statements of cash flows in the exact filed SEC document.
Record the line-item label verbatim, units, fiscal-year dates, and audited versus unaudited filing status.
Distinguish cash purchases of PP&E from accrual additions, commitments, project estimates and financing proceeds.
If consolidated cash capex cannot be attributed to individual LNG facilities, label as company-wide rather than facility-specific.
Reconcile prior-year comparison in same filing; where filings differ, explain restatement.
Only then consider Gap 11 closure; do not equate revenue or operating expense with cash capex.
